summary: Landed the mechanisms the jira-clone witness cell needs and proved its journey facts in the browser, but did not reach the published receipt. Delivered: a real pointer drag primitive and a generic rendered-style probe in playwright-host.ts; angular-jira-clone in WITNESS_REAL_APP_NAMES with a closed drag-surface list admitting drag only there; core test updated. Whole repo gate green (tsc, lint, 1131 node tests, receipt:verify). Browser-proved: drag settles Akita state, the NZ_MODAL_DATA rewrite delivers on both lanes (green, not red), and the 550KB stylesheet difference produces no rendered difference across seven probes. Journey, core schema, runner, runs and evidence remain.
open_questions: Quill description editing cannot be driven by synthetic key events (typed text never enters .ql-editor), so journey (b) can assert the description renders and edit the title only. Confirm dropping description editing, or authorise a different description gesture.

The Sentry envelope POST carries the DSN public key in its sentry_key query, and the generic failed-request inventory records failures by full non-loopback URL. Fulfilling it with 200 application/json {} makes it succeed (zero failed requests, zero console errors) and keeps the DSN out of evidence; the default 204 makes it fail net::ERR_ABORTED and would put the DSN in the inventory. Confirm the 200 transport answer, or authorise a generic query-redaction in the failed-request record.

The remaining work (jira-clone AppSpec/journey, witness-angular-jira-clone.ts schema, runner, four runs, mutation proof, evidence, tests) is roughly three template-sized files plus six browser runs; re-cut as at least two units.
